description: Open 30-minute slots for a free consultation with IRM over the next 1 to 7 days, read live from the calendar. Each slot has a scheduling_url that opens Calendly with that time pre-selected; the person confirms the booking there.

days.description: Number of days to search (1 to 7). Default 7.

service.description: Optional service id the consultation is about (attribution only).

start.description: First day to search, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 date-time. Default: now.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the local times, e.g. America/Toronto. Default America/New_York.

name: check_availability
title: Check consultation availability
